data.name: Determined
data.description: As a standard action, the samurai can spend one use of his resolve to remove the fatigued, shaken, or sickened condition.

raw_tokens.value: As a standard action, the samurai can spend one use of his resolve to remove the fatigued, shaken, or sickened condition.
He can alternatively remove the exhausted, frightened, nauseated, or staggered condition.|PREVARGTEQ:SamuralLVL,8
If the condition has a duration longer than 1 hour or is permanent, this ability removes the condition for 1 hour, at which time the condition returns.
